scope: Numerical engineering checks only: synthetic replay invariants and first8historical validation n10 anchors for each peaks/valleys checkpoint. No four-new-unit test scoring, fitting or accuracy outcome selection.

default_context_failure_record.resolution: Restore the existing frozen runner backend/thread context; no scientific source logic or tolerance was changed. These were historical numerical preflight failures, not formal outcomes.

additional_invariants: L2-L4 actual h0 equals recipient BEFORE state, not native AFTER state.
Layer1, embedding, positions and final_norm are never rerun by replay_upper.
Early and late edited h1 are bit-identical; upper updates differ for a discriminating synthetic fixture.
Donor h1 with recipient previous uppers is distinct from whole-donor-state swap; the latter remains a separate positive wiring control.
Input states remain unchanged; training mode, wrong shapes and non-FP32 states are rejected.
